overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee approved the monthly City Council newsletter draft and discussed planning strategies, locations, and formatting for future resident listening sessions and neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: City Council Newsletter Review
items.summary: Approved the monthly newsletter for publication and circulation, pending edits to incorporate late December updates and clarify specific resolutions.

items.title: Resolution to Establish City Council Listening Sessions
items.summary: Referred the resolution to establish listening sessions back to committee after discussing digital and physical outreach strategies and potential redundancy with proposed ward meetings.

items.title: Resolution to Schedule Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Referred the resolution to committee after discussing meeting formats, scheduling priorities starting with Wards 8 and 4, and techniques to ensure balanced public participation.

subject: City Council Newsletter and Ward Meeting Planning
